name: Harmonic Mean
description: This keyword returns the Harmonic mean of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Harmonic mean of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632397262.png)

You can fetch the Harmonic mean on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot EMA of RSI, OPEN etc
